title: Salesforce Net Zero Cloud Carbon Emission
description: Schema for a carbon emission record in Salesforce Net Zero Cloud, tracking greenhouse gas emissions by scope, source, and reporting period.

Name.description: Auto-generated name for the emission record

EmissionSource.description: The source of the emission (e.g., Natural Gas Combustion, Business Travel)

QuantityMtCO2e.description: Quantity of greenhouse gas emissions in metric tons of CO2 equivalent

ReportingYear.description: The fiscal or calendar year for this emission record

ReportingPeriodStartDate.description: Start date of the reporting period

ReportingPeriodEndDate.description: End date of the reporting period

FacilityId.description: Salesforce ID of the associated facility record

EmissionFactorId.description: Salesforce ID of the emission factor used for calculation

CalculationMethod.description: Method used to calculate the emission quantity

Description.description: Additional description or notes for this emission record

CreatedDate.description: Timestamp when the record was created

LastModifiedDate.description: Timestamp when the record was last modified
